questions.question: Name 4 groups who were included in the NACI recommendations for phase 1 (initial/limited supply) COVID-19 vaccination in December 2020.
questions.question_raw: Name 4 groups who were included in the NACI recommendations for phase 1 Vaccination in December 2020 for COVID-19.

parts.text: Name 4 groups who were included in the NACI recommendations for phase 1 (initial/limited supply) COVID-19 vaccination in December 2020.

parts_raw.text: Name 4 groups who were included in the NACI recommendations for phase 1 Vaccination in December 2020 for COVID-19.

questions.model_answer: (1) Residents and staff of congregate living settings that provide care for seniors (e.g., long-term care homes and assisted-living facilities). (2) Adults 70 years of age and older, beginning with those 80 and older and decreasing in 5-year age increments as supply allowed. (3) Front-line health-care workers (including all who work in health-care settings and personal support workers with direct patient contact). (4) Adults in Indigenous communities.
questions.beyond_mandell: This Mandell chapter (US-focused) contains no NACI or COVID-19 content; answer is from NACI's Guidance on the prioritization of key populations for COVID-19 immunization (updated Dec 2020).
